objective: Test new frozen video evidence on the unchanged development scenario folds before considering camera-uncertainty motion architecture fitting.

data_contract.localization: provider actor tracking boxes; conditional-on-localization benchmark
data_contract.annotation_action_and_occlusion_values: label verification and declared diagnostic strata only; never learned feature inputs or reliability gates
data_contract.inference_limit: Reused development scenarios, not independent confirmation; pretraining overlap with Okutama remains unknown unless independently demonstrated.

archive.hash_policy: opaque byte stream; never archive-wide CRC/decompression scan
archive.annotations: only 42 exact text members for the 21 primary provider recordings
archive.images: only exact requested primary clip JPEG members bound by the manifest allowlist

upstream.pretraining_overlap_status: unknown; frozen weights are not evidence of zero overlap

image_control.representation: frozen final-layer CLS token independently for each of the same sixteen normalized 384x384 native-frame crops
image_control.patch_grid_note: DINOv2 patch size 14 yields a 27x27 token grid at 384 pixels; six trailing pixels per axis are not patchified. No hidden processor resize or center crop is permitted.
image_control.pretraining_overlap_status: unknown; frozen weights are not evidence of zero overlap

sampling.time_origin: center source frame; source frame number divided by 30 for nominal absolute time
sampling.temporal_extent_note: Sixteen distinct native frames, 0.5 seconds between endpoints; explicitly asymmetric by one native frame.
sampling.repeated_center: repeat the slot-8 preprocessed image exactly sixteen times

preprocessing.crop: dynamic per-frame provider box with context_fraction on each side
preprocessing.missing_input_policy: retain center; represent invalid frames explicitly; extraction may fail closed but must not silently drop rows; probe fallback requires a later fitting lock

encoder_cache.spatial_pooling: adaptive average pooling to 3x3 per tubelet

pilot.selection: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 pilot_domain + sample_id; tie-break sample_id

p1_prospective.scope: exploratory representation screen; not authorized by these P0 locks
arms: same unique frames and crops frozen image control
p1_prospective.selection: all learned preprocessing, fitting, tuning and calibration remain inside outer-training scenario folds
